warnings.message: 31 words: Ordinary viewers also need the stream to be live or Keep commands and rewards on while offline switched on; the platform’s broadcaster and moderators, and data-rights commands, bypass that offline gate.
34 words: Without a channel name, the bot uses the one channel where it has seen you chatting in the current session; if there is none or more than one, it asks which channel you mean.
32 words: If the bot reaches its daily whisper limit for new recipients, it can post a short notice in a channel where it has seen you chatting, asking you to use chat instead.
